records.tagline: AI Recruiter Designed for Hiring the Guardians of Tomorrow
records.description: Helen AI helps security companies fill critical roles faster with purpose-trained AI interviews that run 24/7. It automates candidate screening, reduces manual coordination, and delivers a consistent, structured hiring experience for every applicant. Built by experts in psychology and computer science, Helen helps teams cut hiring costs, reduce delays, improve candidate flow, and make better hiring decisions from a centralized dashboard.

records.name: GutCheck Decision App
records.tagline: A 60-second decision-making app that reduces overthinking.
records.description: Gut Check is a 60-second decision tool for people stuck in mental loops. You type your dilemma, answer 7 questions under a ticking timer, and get a recommendation grounded in your own inputs, not someone else's opinion. The timer forces instinct over analysis. By the time it runs out, you've already revealed what you actually want. Gut Check just reflects it back clearly. No frameworks. No journaling. No decision matrices. Just a fast, honest answer from the one person who actually knows: you.

records.name: NasrTech Tools
records.tagline: Free privacy-first browser tools — no upload, no sign-up
records.description: NasrTech Tools is a growing set of free utilities that run 100% in your browser — nothing is uploaded, no account, no watermark. Compress, resize and convert images (PNG/JPG/WebP); generate QR codes (Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, vCard), XML sitemaps, app privacy policies and SEO meta tags; count words; create strong passwords; convert colors (HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH); plus in-browser PDF tools. Built by a solo dev tired of uploading files to sketchy "free" sites for jobs the browser already does.

records.name: Anza
records.tagline: Build browser-native web apps without framework overhead.
records.description: Anza is a browser-native web platform for building modern applications without bundlers, virtual DOMs, or framework lock-in. It combines reactive state, client-side routing, custom elements, offline sync, service workers, animations, and theming into a lightweight ESM-first developer experience. A Rust-powered CLI handles development, HMR, import resolution, and production builds while shipping only the code you actually use.

records.name: Trademark Dashboard
records.tagline: Free UK & US trademark search, monitoring and analytics
records.description: Trademark Dashboard is a free platform for searching, monitoring, and analysing UK and US trademarks. Track filing activity, monitor competitors and your own marks, explore trademark classes, and access live data from the UK IPO and USPTO — all in one dashboard.

records.name: FigureReady
records.tagline: Excel → publication-ready scientific figures in seconds
records.description: Researchers and PhD students waste hours fighting with GraphPad, Origin, or MATLAB just to make a simple figure for their paper. FigureReady fixes this: → Upload your Excel file → Select X and Y columns → Choose ACS or Nature style → Export high-res PNG or SVG That's it. No coding. No installation. Free. Built for researchers who want to focus on their science, not their software. Topics à sélectionner : - Science - Data Visualization - Productivity - Open Source

records.name: AdProtektor
records.tagline: Block ad click fraud by tracking the person, not the IP.
records.description: Stop wasting ad budget on bots, competitors, and click farms. AdProtektor uses AI to identify and block fraudulent clicks in real time. Free trial included.

records.name: Vectoris
records.tagline: Visualize, explore, and understand vectors interactively.
records.description: Vectoris is an interactive vector playground designed for students, educators, and anyone learning vector mathematics. Create vectors, drag them across the coordinate plane, explore their components, and build intuition through visualization instead of memorization. Whether you're studying physics, mathematics, or simply curious about vectors, Vectoris helps make abstract concepts feel intuitive and interactive.

records.name: GENZ Keys
records.tagline: Themes,Fonts and Custom backgrounds set in a keyboard
records.description: Download GENZ Keys free on Android — the best font keyboard with 40+ text styles, 24+ custom keyboard themes, swipe typing, aesthetic key sounds & kaomoji tools. Rated 4.8★ on Google Play.

records.name: MyLinkX
records.tagline: One link. Every destination.
records.description: MyLinkX helps coaches, consultants, creators, and digital product sellers turn their social media traffic into real business results. Create a professional link-in-bio page with booking links, lead capture forms, digital product sales, analytics, and custom branding—all from one place.

records.name: Turbo Lists
records.tagline: AI Powered Lists using Voice and Images
records.description: Track calorie and macro counts, track expenses, manage shopping lists and todos - all with photo OCR, voice transcription, or manual entry.

records.name: Sunasty
records.tagline: 137 file tools that run in your browser, not the cloud
records.description: Your files never leave your device. 137 browser tools to convert, compress and edit files. 100% local, offline, no account.

records.name: Lock Down Keys
records.tagline: AES-256 password manager built for teams
records.description: Lock Down Keys is a zero-knowledge, AES-256-GCM encrypted password manager built for teams. Get shared vaults, one-click offboarding when someone leaves, full audit logs, and a Chrome extension for seamless autofill. A secure, simple alternative to Bitwarden, 1Password, and Dashlane — try free for 14 days, no credit card required.

records.name: RPlanning
records.tagline: Online booking for salons — no app, no account, just a link
records.description: Hey Product Hunt I built RPlanning after watching my local hairdresser lose bookings every evening because clients couldn't reach her outside opening hours. RPlanning gives any salon or independent beauty professional a public booking page in minutes — customers book 24/7 in 3 clicks, get an instant SMS confirmation, and never forget their appointment. No app to download, no account to create. For the salon owner: manage practitioners, set availability, print a QR.

records.name: Tabstack Dev Tools
records.tagline: Ditch your scraper. Make one API call with any tool.
records.description: Ditch your scraper. One API gives your code everything it needs from the web: structured JSON, clean markdown, cited research, and browser automation. No browser, LLM, or pipeline for you to run. Use it from the tools you already work in: an MCP server, CLI, Raycast extension, or as an Agent Skill. Grab a key and make your first call in less than three minutes. Mozilla-backed. Your data is never sold, never trained on.

records.name: MailSpaceAI
records.tagline: Email Tracking & Mail Merge for Gmail – MailSpaceAI®
records.description: MailSpaceAI is the #1 Gmail extension for email tracking, mail merge campaigns, link click tracking, and email analytics. Know when your emails are opened – in real time. Free forever.

records.name: CollectoHub
records.tagline: Manage, trade and showcase your collection
records.description: CollectoHub is an all-in-one platform for collectors. Track your collection, discover new models, organize wishlists, connect with other collectors, and buy, sell or trade collectibles. With a growing database of 75,000+ collectible models across dozens of brands, CollectoHub helps collectors keep everything organized in one place while engaging with a passionate community.

records.name: Velocity
records.tagline: Speed-read any document on iPhone with RSVP & OCR
records.description: RSVP speed reading trainer for iPhone

records.name: Azul
records.tagline: brainstorm your product's brand name with ease
records.description: Fill out the brief, AI will do the rest. Mark favorite names, expand further.

records.name: GymCare
records.tagline: Gym management software - Gymcare
records.description: GymCare is gym management software that automates memberships, billing, and attendance — with a dedicated app for owners, trainers, and members. Book a free demo today.

records.name: Bảng màu Dulux
records.tagline: Cách chọn màu sơn nhà mà không bị "phát điên"
records.description: Trời ơi cái bảng màu Dulux nó nhiều màu kinh khủng. Lần nào chọn màu sơn nhà cũng y như rằng muốn trầm cảm. Nhưng mà tui mới tìm được một cái mẹo hay lắm, nên viết bài này share cho ai cũng đang 'chật vật' giống tui.

records.name: Squirrel
records.tagline: 38 tiny Mac apps for ADHD brains — no subscription
records.description: 38 single-purpose Mac apps for the ADHD brain, built on the neuroscience. Make time visible, beat task paralysis, quiet the 2am spiral. One-time price, no account, nothing ever leaves your Mac; and most importantly we fit into your workflows, we don't force you into ours.

records.name: Context – Read Between the Lines
records.tagline: Understand what people really mean
records.description: Context by Function Labs helps you read between the lines of emails, job ads, rental listings, marketplace posts and documents. It highlights red flags, hidden subtext, missing information and unclear wording, so you can make better decisions before replying, applying, buying or signing.

records.name: AI ROADMAP AND PROGRESS TRACKER
records.tagline: Free 40-week AI Engineer roadmap with daily tasks
records.description: Free 10-month AI Engineer roadmap with 40 weeks of daily tasks: math foundations, classical ML, PyTorch, transformers from scratch, RAG, fine-tuning, agents, ML system design and interview prep. Track your progress, streak, and analytics privately.

records.name: StackFul - InvoixPro
records.tagline: Self-Hosted Invoice, Billing & Subscription Management
records.description: Stop paying monthly fees for invoicing software. InvoixPro is a self-hosted Laravel invoice and billing solution that helps businesses automate invoicing, subscriptions, recurring payments, and customer management. Built for developers, agencies, and SaaS founders who want complete control, customization, and ownership of their billing infrastructure.

records.name: Revenue Cycle Management Services
records.tagline: RevnoRCM
records.description: Revno RCM delivers expert revenue cycle management, medical billing, and HIPAA-compliant RCM services. Maximize reimbursements and reduce denials.

records.name: Bestax Accountants
records.tagline: Bestax Accountants
records.description: Trusted tax, audit, bookkeeping and accounting services in Mississauga. Bestax helps businesses stay compliant, organized and financially confident.

records.name: TempClip Pro
records.tagline: Secure, anonymous, and temporary cross-device clipboard.
records.description: TempClip lets you instantly share text, code, and files up to 100MB across any device. No accounts required. Secure your clips with passwords, custom URLs, and self-destructing timers. Drop a clip, get a link, and grab it anywhere.

records.name: Ashok IT | Learn Here Lead Anywhere!
records.tagline: Java Realtime Project Online Training
records.description: Join the best Java Real-Time Projects Development course with placement. Work on live projects using Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs & gain hands-on experience.

records.name: Sutra
records.tagline: Your local prompt library, inside AI chat
records.description: Sutra is a local-first prompt manager for people who reuse prompts across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Studio. Save prompts, organize them with folders and tags, fill variables, copy rendered text, or type; in supported chat sites to insert from your local library. No signup or cloud sync required for the current local workflow

records.name: قالب عرض تقديمي
records.tagline: قالب عرض تقديمي احترافي
records.description: حمّل آلاف قوالب PowerPoint الاحترافية مجانًا. تصاميم عصرية للأعمال والتعليم والتسويق والتكنولوجيا والمزيد. متوافقة مع Google Slides وKeynote.

records.name: Cliptop
records.tagline: Clipboard history for Mac, right under the notch.
records.description: Cliptop is a fast, local-first clipboard manager for Mac. Open it from the notch or menu bar, search recent copies, preview text, links, code, images, files, and colors, save key items to Pinboards, and paste back without losing focus.

records.name: ImageExtract
records.tagline: Instantly Extract images from any website or Documents
records.description: Extract images from any website, URL, PDF or document in seconds. Fast, clean, and accurate image extraction with smart filtering to remove duplicates and unwanted assets.

records.name: Inspeck
records.tagline: Measure, inspect & edit any live web page — no DevTools
records.description: Inspeck turns any live web page into something you can measure, inspect and edit — no DevTools required. Hover to measure spacing and sizes. Click any element for its real font, color and CSS. Then tweak values inline to preview a fix before it ships. It's design QA without the tab-switching — catch the 2px that drifted, the off-brand pink, the heading that's a size off. Works on any site and runs fully in your browser. Free Chrome extension.

records.name: Grayscale for Safari
records.tagline: Turn Safari black & white and browse with less distraction
records.description: Grayscale is a Safari extension that turns the web black & white so you can browse with less visual stimulation. It works on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Unlike full blockers, it keeps the web usable while making distracting feeds, thumbnails, and colorful interfaces feel calmer. You can enable grayscale globally, then whitelist the sites where color still matters. Built for people who want a lighter, more intentional browsing setup without changing their entire workflow.

records.name: NovaCloud22
records.tagline: NovaCloud22 is a secure all-in-one workspace
records.description: NovaCloud22 is a secure file workspace founded by CEO Rishav Kumar Jha. Store, share, collect, protect, and work with files using built-in productivity tools, multi-drive support, AES-256 encryption, and advanced sharing controls. Made in India.

records.name: Adapt
records.tagline: The AI company brain that does work for you
records.description: Transform your Slack into an AI workspace with a shared company brain. Set it up once, connect to every tool, and anyone can tag @Adapt to answer questions, build apps, and get work done.

records.name: Buddy Figma Agent
records.tagline: Free Figma agent + Import anything to Figma
records.description: Buddy is the most powerful AI design agent inside Figma. And if you already pay for ChatGPT, plug it in and chat for free. No AI credits. Generate screens, flows, and variants on your canvas. Clone any website, import Claude design/artifacts, or drop a screenshot to get editable Figma layers. Run parallel agents at the same time, organize your file, and stay on-brand with your design system. You're already paying for AI. Now use it right inside Figma.

records.name: Locofy: design-to-code agents
records.tagline: Agentic frontend layer between Figma and Cursor & Claude
records.description: Locofy is the agentic frontend layer between Figma and Cursor & Claude. Using proprietary design-aware models combined with LLMs, Locofy converts Figma designs into structured, responsive, pixel-perfect frontend code and works directly from the CLI, Cursor, Claude Code, and others. While coding agents excel at logic and iteration, they still struggle with UI precision and Figma structure — Locofy provides the frontend foundation they can reliably build on.

records.name: Splice
records.tagline: Emojis and GIFs, Anywhere on Your Mac
records.description: Splice brings the Discord-style `:` emoji flow to macOS. Type `:` anywhere, search fast, use custom keywords, save favorites, and insert emojis without breaking your flow. It also includes GIFs and app-specific behavior, making emoji and GIF input feel faster, smarter, and more native across your Mac.

records.name: Bharat OS
records.tagline: India's first vibecoded OS
records.description: Bharat OS is a lightweight OS That serves in India primarily Managed by: TechForges OS Partners: Microsoft, Apple, Linux Kernel, Cursor AI, Claude AI, OpenAI What's unique: India's first Vibecoded OS What is OS: Operating System Indian Languages Founded by a unicorn startup: TechForges Technologies Motive: Fight digital literacy and empower people Goal: Make India ready for cybersecurity attacks Vison: Protecting India by a backup OS system and regular Purpose: To empower people

records.name: Trading Diary: Trade Journal for iPad
records.tagline: Trading Journal with focus on risk and position sizing
records.description: Trading Diary is an iPad trade journal for serious traders who want to plan better, manage risk, and improve discipline. Calculate position size, manage planned/open/closed trades, attach charts, grade entries and exits, review stats, track your equity curve, and learn from every decision. Built for stocks, futures, crypto, and forex, with trade records stored locally on your iPad for more privacy and control.

records.name: Supapin 2.0
records.tagline: Turn any URL into scroll-stopping Pinterest pins
records.description: Supapin turns any URL into ready-to-use Pinterest pins. Paste a link and it generates polished pin designs with AI-written, SEO-optimized titles and descriptions. Edit anything, or rewrite the copy with AI in one click. Then schedule and publish to Pinterest, choosing the board for each pin. Creating pins is free. You only spend credits when you download, schedule, or publish.

records.name: GameHzLab — Game DNA
records.tagline: Your Game DNA — free browser games matched to your mood
records.description: GameHzLab scores every game on 6 traits — Stamina, Mental, Reaction, Luck, Healing, Social — and matches 200+ free browser games to your current mood. Take the Game DNA test, get your radar + archetype, and play instantly. No downloads, no signup.

records.name: Mercury Consulting
records.tagline: Business Consulting and Services, Golden Visa Consultants
records.description: Mercury Consulting is a provider of corporate, trust, immigration, and related services. Operating through our offices in the key locations of Cyprus and Singapore. Our clients range from individual entrepreneurs and investors to global business groups. Our services are directed at clients engaged in international business or investment ventures. If you are searching for a reliable partner to guide you on Cyprus Golden Visa, then you should speak to us. We can make the journey more exciting!

records.name: Lumina Clippers
records.tagline: The clipping agency behind 18B+ views
records.description: Lumina Clippers turns one long-form video — a podcast, interview, livestream or demo — into dozens of short clips and distributes them across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and X through a managed network of 62,900+ vetted creators. Every clip is human-reviewed. We've delivered 18B+ verified views (Stake 1.8B+, Rollbit 1.1B+, Photon 962M+, OKX 248M+) on a transparent $1–5 CPM, launching in 24–72 hours. Built for B2B, SaaS, AI and crypto brands that want reach, not just clips.

records.name: OPEN QR
records.tagline: 100% offline, privacy-first QR builder with terminal UI
records.description: Open QR is an enterprise-grade, privacy-focused offline QR utility designed with a sleek developer terminal-style UI. Its secure local engine ensures that your sensitive data-such as Wi-Fi credentials, vCards, or URLs-never leaves your browser. Generate high-quality QR assets locally with custom geometric patterns, corporate branding, and a high error-correction matrix for maximum reliability. 100% open-source and tracker-free.

records.name: CashOut
records.tagline: Block sports betting apps, track how much you saved
records.description: You've seen it everywhere. Every ad break, every broadcast, every group chat. In just a few years, sports betting went from taboo to unavoidable, run by companies that profit when you lose and design their apps to keep vulnerable people addicted. CashOut fights back. It blocks every sportsbook on your phone. No bypass. You've got to wait 16 hours. Track what you're winning instead: money saved, days stayed clean. Help yourself or a loved one fight back. Download CashOut for free.

records.name: Trinket.io now openSource!
records.tagline: Free Coding editor for schools: P5, Python, Java, R, HTML...
records.description: I really appreciate it when services open source their software when they shut down. There's so many amazing sites, software, games, are gone forever because there's no way to access it or replicate it. Trinket.io did exactly that, and now Strive Math have decided to host it for free at trinket.strivemath.org Made for educators, kept alive by educators: no paywalls, no cost. Run Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and p5.js in your browser, share it with your students, and know it's here to stay.

records.name: Searcheek
records.tagline: A connection and collaboration-based ai assistant.
records.description: Think of it as ChatGPT with a collaborative twist. Explore ideas, add people, and invite friends to any chat session—all in real time. Whether researching or brainstorming, everyone contributes together. The core exists, but we're going further: better responses, multiple AI models, real-time deep research, and stronger admin controls. The upcoming version also adds simple text messaging alongside AI replies, making conversations more flexible and human-centric.

records.name: KeyboardKeyboard —
records.tagline: Your computer keyboard is a real grand piano
records.description: Press any key and your keyboard sings. KeyboardKeyboard turns your laptop into a playable grand piano, right in the browser — real sampled piano sound, full chords, about 3 octaves across two key rows, labels that auto-match your keyboard layout, plus optional MIDI keyboard support with velocity and a sustain pedal. Free, no sign-up.
